boot.failedDescription: Kutup could not be reached, or signing in through your account did not finish. Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist in Pass.

vaults.title: Vaults
vaults.description: Your passwords, in KeePass vaults kept in Drive. Edits made offline are saved when you are back online.
vaults.loadFailed: Some vaults could not be listed. Check your connection and reload.
vaults.newDescription: A KeePass vault in Drive, encrypted with its own password and again by Drive. KeePassXC and other KeePass apps open it too.
vaults.name: Vault name
vaults.folderDescription: Where the vault file is kept in Drive. Everyone who can open the folder can open the vault file; only its key opens what is inside.
vaults.passwordDescription: The password KeePass apps ask for. With “Unlock with my Kutup sign-in”, Pass and kutup sync do not ask for it.
vaults.needsKey: A vault needs a password, a key file, or both.
vaults.createFailed: The vault could not be created. Check your connection and try again.
vaults.emptyDescription: Make a vault for your passwords. It is a KeePass file in your Drive, so KeePassXC and the kutup command line can open it too.
vaults.notFoundDescription: This vault does not exist any more, or you cannot open it.
vaults.keepassNote: Vaults are KeePass 4 files (.kdbx). On a computer, `kutup sync` keeps a folder of them for KeePassXC and merges edits made on both sides.

unlock.title: Unlock {{name}}
unlock.description: Enter the vault's password or key file.
unlock.rememberDescription: Keeps the vault's key in your account, sealed with your account key: Pass and kutup sync open the vault without asking. KeePass apps still ask for it.
unlock.wrongKey: That password or key file does not open this vault.
unlock.unreachable: Kutup could not be reached, and this device has no copy of the vault. Check your connection.
unlock.keptStale: The key your account keeps no longer opens this vault: its password was probably changed elsewhere. Enter the new one.
unlock.keepFailed: The vault's key could not be kept in your account; you will be asked for it next time.
unlock.accountPasswordDescription: This vault was locked on this device. Your account password opens it again; Kutup checks it as at sign-in.
unlock.wrongAccountPassword: That is not your Kutup password.
unlock.paused: Too many wrong passwords: your account is locked for a while, as at sign-in. Use the vault's own key below.
unlock.checkUnreachable: Kutup could not be reached to check your password. Enter the vault's key instead.
unlock.pinDescription: The six-digit PIN of your Kutup account.
unlock.wrongPin_one: Wrong PIN. {{count}} more try, then you are signed out.
unlock.wrongPin_other: Wrong PIN. {{count}} more tries, then you are signed out.
unlock.pinSignedOut: Too many wrong PINs: you were signed out. Sign in again with your password.
unlock.pinRemoved: The PIN was removed, perhaps on another device. Use your account password; you can set a PIN again in the settings.

sync.offlineDescription: Kutup cannot be reached. Your changes are kept on this device and saved when the connection is back.
sync.quotaDescription: Your storage is full, so the vault's changes are only on this device. Free some space and they are saved.

merge.title: Merged with another device
merge.review_one: {{count}} entry was changed on both: one version is shown, the other is in its history.
merge.review_other: {{count}} entries were changed on both: one version is shown, the other is in their history.
merge.restored_one: {{count}} entry deleted elsewhere was kept because it was edited here.
merge.restored_other: {{count}} entries deleted elsewhere were kept because they were edited here.
merge.settings: Vault settings changed on both; this device's were kept.

review.title: Changed on two devices
review.description: These fields were edited on two devices: {{fields}}. One version is shown here; the other is in the history.

theirsKey.title: The vault has a new key
theirsKey.description: Another device saved this vault with a new password or key file. Enter it to merge your changes; it is used from now on.

vault.keyForgotten: The vault's key is no longer kept in your account
vault.forgetFailed: The vault's key could not be forgotten. Try again.
vault.nameTaken: A file with that name is already in this folder.

groups.label: Groups
groups.name: Group name
groups.deleteDescription: {{name}} and everything in it go to the recycle bin.
groups.deleteForGoodDescription: {{name}} and everything in it are deleted for good.
groups.emptyBinDescription: Everything in the recycle bin is deleted for good, on every device that syncs this vault.

entries.label: Entries
entries.pick: Choose an entry to see it.

entry.title: Title
entry.otpDescription: An otpauth:// link or the secret key a site shows when you turn on two-step sign-in.
entry.otpInvalid: The one-time code secret is not an otpauth:// link or a base32 key.
entry.fieldNameTaken: Two fields have the same name, or a field uses a reserved name.
entry.saveFailed: The change could not be made.

detail.deleteTitle: Move this entry to the recycle bin?
detail.deleteDescription: {{title}} goes to the recycle bin; you can restore it from there.
detail.deleteForGoodDescription: {{title}} is deleted for good, on every device that syncs this vault.
detail.attachmentTooLarge: A file can be at most 50 MB.
detail.clipboardNotCleared: Copied secrets could not be cleared from the clipboard: allow clipboard access, or clear it yourself.

history.title: Earlier versions
history.description: Each change keeps the entry as it was before. Restoring one keeps the current version in the history too.

autoLock.label: Lock vaults after
autoLock.description: Open vaults lock by themselves after this long without use on this device, and always when you sign out.

report.title: Security report
report.private: Worked out here from the open vault; no password, hash or part of one is sent anywhere.
report.weakDescription: Short or simple enough to guess. Replace them with generated ones.
report.reusedDescription: The same password in more than one entry: one leak opens them all.
report.expiredDescription: Past the expiry date set on them.

unlockMode.label: After a lock, open vaults with
unlockMode.description: On this device, a vault that locked (by hand or after idling) opens again with this. Vaults without a kept key always ask for their own key.

siteIcons.label: Website icons
siteIcons.description: Whether entries show their website's icon, on every device.

about.kutup: Your Kutup server fetches each entry's website icon, so the websites never see your browser. The server sees only the website's name. Applies on every device.
about.off: Entries show their first letter, and no website or server is asked. Applies on every device.

siteIcons.saveFailed: Could not save the setting. Try again.

import.title: Import passwords
import.description: From another password manager's CSV export: KeePassXC, Bitwarden, 1Password, LastPass, Proton Pass, NordPass, Dashlane, Chrome, Edge, Brave, Firefox, Safari or Apple Passwords, or any CSV with named columns.
import.formatDescription: Worked out from the file's columns; pick one if it guessed wrong.
import.intoDescription: A new group at the top of the vault, so the import can be looked over or deleted at once.
import.failed: The import could not be made; the vault is unchanged.
import.deleteExport: An export file holds your passwords unencrypted. Delete it (and empty the trash) once they are imported.

errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MB.
errors.unreadable: The file could not be read as CSV. Export it again as UTF-8. {{detail}}
errors.unknownFormat: These columns do not look like a password export. Pick its format, or name the columns (Title, Username, Password, URL, Notes).
errors.missingColumns: The file lacks columns this format has: {{detail}}.
errors.tooMany: The file holds more than 50,000 entries.

pin.description: Six digits that unlock your vaults after Kasa locks them, on every device where you choose the PIN. Kutup checks it; three wrong PINs in a row sign you out.
pin.removeDescription: Vaults then unlock with your account password where the PIN was used.
pin.passwordDescription: Your Kutup account password, to confirm it is you.
